final_codes.title: Acute pyelonephritis
evidence_quotes: homa 39.1, rigors, R flank pain, CVA tenderness marked.
final_codes.reasoning: The patient's condition escalated from a lower urinary tract infection to acute pyelonephritis, characterized by high fever (39.1), rigors, right flank pain, and marked costovertebral angle tenderness. Per GDL-007, the presence of systemic symptoms, flank pain, and CVA tenderness indicates upper tract involvement (pyelonephritis), which represents the end state diagnosis.
